title: Add control-plane latency and reconnect measurement
description: Measure representative control-plane latency, action completion, and tunnel reconnect/recovery time under a defined workload.
acceptanceCriteria: The harness measures p50/p95 or equivalent latency for health, list, action, and status operations
Reconnect/recovery measurement identifies the process/tunnel fixture and failure injection method
Results include request counts, failures, timeouts, and host/artifact metadata
A candidate run can be compared to baseline using the same workload and is not marked passing on missing samples

steps.details: Choose safe local fixtures for each method category and document which operations are mocked versus real.
Test percentile/latency aggregation and failure/timeout accounting with synthetic samples.
Use bounded concurrency, timeouts, and monotonic timing; collect reconnect/recovery samples without secrets.
Run baseline/candidate measurements, record evidence, and identify any method/VPS coverage gap.

technicalNotes: Do not call a mocked process test a real tunnel benchmark; label evidence levels explicitly.
